Under general supervision of the HR Supervisor, the Academic Personnel Coordinator provides analytical and administrative support on all actions pertaining to academic personnel in the Yellow Cluster. Serve as primary resource and contact for academic personnel policy and practice to ensure compliance with University policy and procedures. Assist with all aspects of the annual academic review process; analyzes, reviews, and prepares actions including appointments, merits, promotions, appraisals, leaves, changes in status, salary adjustments, appeals and visas. Provide administrative and analytical support for the recruitment process for non-senate academic positions, and serve as a resource, providing advice, interpretation, and guidance regarding academic personnel issues for chairs, directors, faculty, managers, and staff. Responsible for providing financial analysis for new and continuing academics as well as providing administrative support on various projects for the Chairs, Directors and CAO.
Demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity and contributing to an inclusive working and learning environment.
Interpersonal skills to interact and communicate effectively and professionally with administration, faculty, staff, visitors, and volunteers.
Skills to work effectively and sensitively with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds and perspectives to build mutual respect, fairness, and equity.

Written and oral communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of department and campus management. Proofreading, editing, grammar and spelling skills. Basic computer skills to use email and log into various UC Davis software systems.
